instruction: I'm using a Ubuntu system. Please set Evince as the default PDF viewer.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets Evince as the default PDF viewer. Uses custom getter get_default_pdf_viewer__bdb427f6 which checks the application/pdf MIME type handler using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default PDF viewer includes 'evince.desktop'.
metadata.verification: The getter queries the default handler for application/pdf MIME type using xdg-mime. The metric check_include_exclude verifies that 'evince.desktop' appears in the result, confirming Evince is set as the default PDF viewer.
